trans-unit.source: Lets visitors pick their country, so prices are shown with that country's tax before they have an address.
trans-unit.target: Lets visitors pick their country, so prices are shown with that country's tax before they have an address.

trans-unit.source: Remove the module and its settings? Customer addresses are not touched.
trans-unit.target: Remove the module and its settings? Customer addresses are not touched.

trans-unit.source: The selector lists the countries enabled under International > Locations > Countries, and only one is enabled right now, so visitors have nothing to choose from.
trans-unit.target: The selector lists the countries enabled under International > Locations > Countries, and only one is enabled right now, so visitors have nothing to choose from.

trans-unit.source: Visitors will be able to pick from: %countries%.
trans-unit.target: Visitors will be able to pick from: %countries%.

trans-unit.source: The choice sets the country PrestaShop uses to work out tax, so prices follow your tax rules without this module calculating anything itself.
trans-unit.target: The choice sets the country PrestaShop uses to work out tax, so prices follow your tax rules without this module calculating anything itself.

trans-unit.source: Once a customer has an address on their cart, that address wins and the selector no longer affects prices.
trans-unit.target: Once a customer has an address on their cart, that address wins and the selector no longer affects prices.

trans-unit.source: These customer groups are set to show prices without tax: %groups%. Their members will not see prices change when they pick a country, because there is no tax in the figure to change.

trans-unit.source: Puts the selector in the shop header.
trans-unit.target: Puts the selector in the shop header.

trans-unit.source: Some themes render the navigation hooks in a hidden container, and the selector is then in the page but invisible. Switch to the top of the header if you see nothing.
